limitations: Only one Gmail account (subscriptions.5@faiblemedia.com) was accessible; earliest message found is 2026-02-11 (Google Workspace welcome). A search for mail before that date returned nothing.
Search results are keyword/vendor based; the connector returns pages of up to 50 threads and shows only the 5 oldest messages per thread. Not every message in the mailbox was individually opened.
PDF invoice attachments could not be read; amounts were taken from email bodies. Freepik/Magnific tax/subtotal detail not available.
31 Freepik/Magnific credit top-up confirmations contain no amount, so spend is understated by an unknown amount.
Adobe Creative Cloud Pro has an order confirmation but no payment receipts; its charges are not counted.
Spam and trash were not searched except in one targeted query; emails the connector filters as suspicious are excluded.
No failed payments, refunds or credit notes were found in the searches run (none of the searched terms returned any).

subscriptions.verification_notes: Six monthly Stripe receipts, Starter Plan, INR 223.00 each. Next renewal date inferred from the Oct 18-Nov 18 billing period on latest receipt; no renewal notice. A 'Starter plan is active' activation email dated 2026-09-20 (msg 1a0be4573bdaca49) conflicts with receipts since May and was not counted as a payment. Promotional upgrade emails are not payments.

subscriptions.plan_name: Premium+ (45,000 AI credits/month per welcome email)
subscriptions.verification_notes: Seven paid invoices at INR 3,540.00. GAP: no invoice found for ~2026-08-16, and the billing date shifts to the 1st (Sep 1, Oct 1). Possible missed invoice, plan change, or second subscription - needs human check. Next renewal date not stated in any email. Freepik announced rebrand to Magnific on 2026-04-28. Additional 'extra credits' purchases listed separately (amounts unknown).

31 'Extra credits added to your counter!' confirmations (15 Freepik, 16 Magnific) between 2026-03-26 and 2026-06-03. These emails confirm a credit purchase but state NO amount, so no spend is recorded. Could include auto top-ups. Check Stripe/bank statements for amounts.

Cancellation confirmed 2026-10-23; account active until 2026-11-07 so no further renewal expected. Plan price USD 29.00 + 18% India GST (USD 5.22) = USD 34.22 from Sep 2026. First invoice had no GST line.
Three credit-pack orders (USD 29.90, 29.90, 9.90). No recurring-plan evidence. Order confirmations rather than card receipts, so card currency/FX not shown.

subscriptions.verification_notes: Order confirmation only. Terms say 50% of remaining contract obligation is charged if cancelled after 14 days. Adobe promotional emails continue through 2026-10-23, suggesting membership still active, but no billing emails were found. Needs verification against card statements.
Emails say 'You previously subscribed to SJinn' (2026-08-27) and follow up on a cancellation (2026-10-07). No receipts, invoices, amounts, or cancellation date found, so spend is unknown.
Team workspace invite (2026-04-02), frequent new-device sign-in alerts, enterprise sales emails, and a Link 'Pay faster at Higgsfield Inc.' email (2026-08-10). No invoice or receipt found.
'Welcome to Google Workspace' on 2026-02-11 (earliest email in mailbox). No billing statements or invoices in the mailbox; billing may be handled on a different admin account.
Welcome email 2026-03-26 and upgrade promotions only. No payment evidence.
Joined as FREE member 2026-08-21; subsequent emails are promos for a paid tier. No payment found.
Only 'new sign-in' security emails (2026-09-24, 2026-10-05). No billing evidence of a paid plan.
Marketing emails only; no billing or plan evidence.
